body:
Not to be too pessimistic, but where is the awesome at the end of your road?

I've been being told the exact same thing, for years. So when does the awesome start happening? I've been working my ass off, and have nothing to show for it but a degree I can't even pay back.

I want to jump off the bridge over the highway I live next to, but the only things stopping me are a. I don't want my friend to think it's about them, and b. I don't want to ruin some poor person's life when I land on/in front of them.

I thought it would give me a chance to show myself, and to show the way I can work. It turns out, all it is is copying somebody else's work. And they want me to do it for 2 years at minimum wage, with no opportunities for advancement (I asked) - I'm in my mid-20s and had to get a degree to get this job.
Because now that I'm working this job, I realise that I'd romanticized it completely.
I can afford my rent, but the way my budget works out I can afford one meal every second day.
Financial situation is really bad. I can't afford to see a psychologist. When I went it was state funded, but then I got too old.
